summary_md:
# #453 Hackat eller malet

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-10-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts go through the Hacksaw profit warning, which several of them sold into at the open, and how it knocked down other 'Twitter darling' small caps such as Chefello. They also argue that drawdowns in small caps are normal and not something only Twitter favourites suffer. They are positive on Zinzino, Avarda Bank (formerly TF Bank) and Liberty Latin America, and in the commodities corner they favour thermal coal and offshore drilling, while warning that a strong El Niño could hit the economy in 2027.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 HACK — Hacksaw | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Hosts sold after the profit warning. One would consider buying if game reviews improve or Q4 is strong, given the very low valuation.

#### Reasoning

Q3 hurt by weak game releases, a lost OpenRGS customer and the structural threat of Stake's in-house slot engine and streamer promotion. The 30% growth target is seen as unrealistic. Valuation is low (EV/FCF <10, ~10% yield, EV/EBIT 7), but there are no institutional buyers and sentiment is broken, so the downtrend may continue until there is a catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued weak game reviews
- further customer losses to Stake's own slots
- weak Q4 report

> *"Så jag tror att det är mycket möjligt att jag kommer köpa in mig i en aktien. Men då vill jag helst först se antingen att liksom spelen börjar tas emot bättre."*

---

### 🟢 CHEF — Chefello | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fell on Hacksaw read-through without any news of its own. Host used the Hacksaw sale proceeds to buy more.

#### Reasoning

The drop was driven by Twitter-darling investors using Chefello as liquidity, not by its own fundamentals. The host took the forced selling as a chance to add.

#### Sell Triggers

- company-specific negative news
- continued forced selling from the small-cap Twitter bubble

> *"Jag köp passade faktiskt på att köpa några fler Shefelloaktier för likviden där också."*

---

### 🟢 ZZ-B — Zinzino | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Q3 sales +18%, YTD +21%, in line with guidance. Trades at ~P/E 12, the low end of the 10-15 buy range. Host increased his position.

#### Reasoning

Consistent delivery of >20% growth with >11% margin. Diversification has reduced the MLM regulatory risk. The stock is volatile, but the host sees P/E 10-15 as a buy zone and ~20 as fair value. Next report is on 17 November, and the stock has historically risen on reports.

#### Sell Triggers

- growth falls below 20%
- margin falls below 11%
- P/E re-rates to 30-40
- major MLM regulatory action

> *"Jag tycker att den här aktien känns ganska bra just nu. Jag ägde den sen innan, men jag använde lite av de här likviderna för att öka lite grann också."*

---

### 🟢 LILA — Liberty Latin America | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell ~10% on SpaceX spectrum news. Host sees a buy-the-dip, because LILA does not operate in the US and is a SpaceX partner.

#### Reasoning

The satellite-to-phone threat was already in the bear case, works poorly in cities, and spectrum is heavily regulated. Free cash flow is not affected and the case should play out before satellite service spreads widely.

#### Sell Triggers

- satellite direct-to-device takes meaningful share in its markets
- SpaceX partnership ends

> *"Jag tror väl kanske att det var lite by the dip-läge där."*

---

### 🟢 TFBANK — Avarda Bank (TF Bank) | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Q3 grew ~30% across the board and German credit-card users +34%. P/E 12-13 on next year. Host still owns and added Hacksaw proceeds.

#### Reasoning

10-year CAGR of 23% in operating profit. German credit cards carry double the margin, lower losses and longer customer relationships. Large addressable market and a possible AI back-office productivity gain. Risks: credit losses rising from 4.5% to 5.1%, rising rates and higher expectations after a 25% rise.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit losses keep rising
- rising rates squeeze funding costs
- growth in German cards slows

> *"Jag tycker fortfarande att Varda, jag har fortfarande lite position. Jag tog lite hack so-pengar att stoppa in här också."*

---

### 🟢 CNR — Core Natural Resources | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Part of the host's thermal coal thesis: coal prices are rising while the stocks lag. Coal miners trade at 2-3x EBITDA.

#### Reasoning

Newcastle coal is at $150 while gas trades at a coal-equivalent ~$300. Miners are cheap, with limited capex needs and no analyst coverage. Q3 reports could close the gap between coal prices and share prices. CNR is mentioned as a less pure US alternative to the Australian names.

#### Sell Triggers

- gas prices collapse and close the gap
- coal prices fall sharply

> *"du har till exempel Core National Resources, som är, ja, det är väl liksom hyfsat bra play på den här tesen."*

---

### 🟠 GLEN — Glencore | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Mentioned as an alternative way to get coal exposure within the coal thesis.

#### Reasoning

A diversified miner with coal exposure, offered as an alternative for investors who cannot trade Australian pure plays. Mentioned only in passing.

#### Sell Triggers

- coal thesis breaks on gas price normalization

> *"Även Glencore till exempel, listat i London som pratats om tidigare."*

---

### ⛔ ADBE — Adobe | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hosts have no explicit take but note weak sentiment and the erosion of software moats from AI reverse-engineering.

#### Reasoning

The open-source AI clone currently works poorly, so the direct revenue hit is likely small (mainly individuals and small agencies). Moat erosion is a longer-term concern and sentiment remains weak.

> *"Ja, vi har ingen take i övrigt tror jag på Adobes aktie. Det känns ju dock fortfarande svagt sentiment i den."*

---
